1) Background / Context

Flarum is a simple yet powerful discussion platform designed to facilitate community engagement and interaction. It caters to a wide range of community sizes, from small groups to enterprise-level organizations. Built on a core framework, Flarum is highly extensible and offers extensive customization options through various extensions.

 2) Objectives

- Develop a discussion platform that supports community interaction.
- Provide extensibility and customization to meet diverse community needs.
- Ensure scalable performance regardless of community size.

 3) Stakeholders & Users

- Community Members: Users who participate in discussions.
- Administrators: Users who manage and customize the forum.
- Developers: Individuals or teams extending/customizing the platform.

 4) Functional Descriptions

- User Registration: Users can create accounts to participate in discussions.
- Permission Management: Configurable permission groups for access control and defining actions like moderation.
- Discussion and Post Management: Users can create, comment, and manage discussions and posts.
- Content Editing: Support for simple editors like bbcode/markdown and WYSIWYG for creating posts.
- Theme and Style Customization: Administrators can customize appearance via themes and custom CSS.
- Real-time Interaction: Notifications and updates through in-browser and email communication. Option for websocket integration for real-time updates.
- Extension Support: Facility to extend functionality through numerous available extensions or custom development.

 5) Non-Functional Descriptions

- Scalability: Capable of supporting communities of varying sizes efficiently.
- Extensibility: Hundreds of extensions available with options for further customization.
- Usability: Intuitive interface for both community members and administrators.
- Security: Secure handling of user data and transactions, with features like tokenized access and API key management.
- Performance: Optimized to ensure quick response times and fluid user experience even under heavy load.

-- Schema for database: schemabench_0014
CREATE TABLE `community_members` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `username` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `password` char(60) NOT NULL,
  `role` enum('member','administrator','developer') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `username` (`username`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `permissions` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `permission_groups` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `group_permissions` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `group_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `permission_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `group_id` (`group_id`),
  KEY `permission_id` (`permission_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `group_permissions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`group_id`) REFERENCES `permission_groups` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `group_permissions_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`permission_id`) REFERENCES `permissions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `discussions` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `author_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `author_id` (`author_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `discussions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`author_id`) REFERENCES `community_members` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `posts` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `content` text NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `discussion_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `author_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `discussion_id` (`discussion_id`),
  KEY `author_id` (`author_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `posts_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`discussion_id`) REFERENCES `discussions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `posts_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`author_id`) REFERENCES `community_members` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `themes` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `css` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `community_members_themes` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `member_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `theme_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `member_id` (`member_id`),
  KEY `theme_id` (`theme_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `community_members_themes_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`member_id`) REFERENCES `community_members` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `community_members_themes_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`theme_id`) REFERENCES `themes` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `notifications` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `type` enum('mention','comment','reply') NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `read_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `recipient_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `recipient_id` (`recipient_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `notifications_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`recipient_id`) REFERENCES `community_members` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `extensions` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `community_members_extensions` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `member_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `extension_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `member_id` (`member_id`),
  KEY `extension_id` (`extension_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `community_members_extensions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`member_id`) REFERENCES `community_members` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `community_members_extensions_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`extension_id`) REFERENCES `extensions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
